//: Telemetry sink. Events go to RaftLabs' own admin API — no third-party processor and no credential on developer machines, so there is nothing here to leak. If the endpoint is unreachable (not yet deployed, or offline) events stay spooled locally and retry on the next session; nothing is lost. The RAFTKIT_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT override applies ONLY when RAFTKIT_DEV=1, so a checked-in project env block cannot redirect telemetry. Opting out needs no such flag: RAFTKIT_TELEMETRY=off and DO_NOT_TRACK are always honoured. Blockers surface in the admin dashboard, not as GitHub issues — see the Telemetry section of raftkit-core/house-rules.
